title: 28. Numeracy & Number Systems: Comparing Magnitudes and Signed Values
description: A comprehensive mathematics curriculum progressing from foundational numeracy and core mathematical concepts to algebra, geometry, calculus, linear algebra, probability, statistics, discrete mathematics, optimization, mathematical foundations of AI, advanced pure mathematics, and emerging research methods.

questions.learningObjective: Determine which of two integers has the greater absolute value.
questions.question: Which number has the greater absolute value, \(-9\) or \(6\)?
questions.explanation: The absolute value of \(-9\) is \(9\), since \(-9\) is \(9\) units from \(0\) on the number line. The absolute value of \(6\) is \(6\). Since \(9>6\), the number \(-9\) has the greater absolute value. Therefore, the correct answer is \(-9\).
questions.hint: Compare the distance of each integer from \(0\).

questions.learningObjective: Determine which of two signed integers is smaller.
questions.question: Which integer is smaller, \(-4\) or \(2\)?
questions.explanation: On a number line, integers increase from left to right. The integer \(-4\) is to the left of \(2\), so \(-4<2\). Therefore, the smaller integer is \(-4\).
questions.hint: On a number line, the integer farther left is smaller.

questions.learningObjective: Determine which of two negative integers is greater.
questions.question: Which integer is greater, \(-7\) or \(-3\)?
questions.explanation: On a number line, \(-7\) is to the left of \(-3\), so \(-7<-3\). Therefore, \(-3\) is greater than \(-7\). The correct answer is \(-3\).
questions.hint: Picture \(-7\) and \(-3\) on a number line. Which one is farther to the right?

questions.learningObjective: Determine which of two integers has the smaller absolute value.
questions.question: Which number has the smaller absolute value, \(-8\) or \(3\)?
questions.explanation: The absolute value of \(-8\) is \(8\), and the absolute value of \(3\) is \(3\). Since \(3<8\), the number \(3\) has the smaller absolute value. Therefore, the correct answer is \(3\).
questions.hint: Compare the distance of each integer from \(0\).

questions.learningObjective: Determine which of two integers is farther from zero on a number line.
questions.question: Which integer is farther from \(0\) on a number line, \(-10\) or \(7\)?
questions.explanation: The distance of \(-10\) from \(0\) is \(10\), and the distance of \(7\) from \(0\) is \(7\). Since \(10>7\), the integer \(-10\) is farther from \(0\). Therefore, the correct answer is \(-10\).
questions.hint: Distance from \(0\) is the absolute value of the integer.

questions.learningObjective: Identify a true comparison statement involving a negative integer and a positive integer.
questions.question: Which statement is true about \(-6\) and \(2\)?
questions.explanation: On a number line, \(-6\) is to the left of \(2\), so \(-6\) is less than \(2\). Therefore, the true statement is \(-6<2\).
questions.hint: Picture \(-6\) and \(2\) on a number line. Which one is farther to the left?

questions.learningObjective: Arrange three signed integers from least to greatest.
questions.question: Which list shows \(-5\), \(3\), and \(-1\) in order from least to greatest?
questions.explanation: On a number line, the order from left to right is \(-5\), \(-1\), \(3\). Since least to greatest follows the left-to-right order, the correct list is \(-5\), \(-1\), \(3\).
questions.hint: Place the integers on a number line and read from left to right.

questions.learningObjective: Arrange three signed integers from greatest to least.
questions.question: Which list shows \(4\), \(-2\), and \(0\) in order from greatest to least?
questions.explanation: On a number line, the greatest integer is farthest to the right. The order from greatest to least is \(4\), \(0\), \(-2\). Therefore, the correct list is \(4\), \(0\), \(-2\).
questions.hint: Arrange the integers from right to left on a number line.

questions.learningObjective: Compare the absolute values of two negative integers.
questions.question: Which absolute value is greater, \(|-3|\) or \(|-7|\)?
questions.explanation: Evaluate each absolute value: \(|-3|=3\) and \(|-7|=7\). Since \(7>3\), the absolute value \(|-7|\) is greater.
questions.hint: First evaluate each absolute value, then compare the results.

questions.learningObjective: Determine the correct inequality between a negative integer and a positive integer.
questions.question: If \(a=-12\) and \(b=9\), which statement is true?
questions.explanation: The integer \(a=-12\) is negative, and \(b=9\) is positive. On a number line, every negative integer is to the left of every positive integer, so \(-12<9\). Therefore, the true statement is \(a<b\).
questions.hint: Compare the positions of a negative integer and a positive integer on a number line.
